svg.title: Museum arrival: adapt directions to a glance at an entrance
svg.desc: The same ticket desk, upstairs collection and lift information changes from a small paragraph to two separated groups with larger labels. Only four direction text nodes, their type sizes and baselines change. Title, photograph, crop, paper, colors and all other styling remain identical. This is not a validated accessible wayfinding system.
svg.metadata: Original fictional Patternverse teaching example. Photographic illustrations are generated and identical image bytes are reused within the pair. g.text: is upstairs. Lift access is beside

svg.text: Directions are regrouped and enlarged. Title, facts, photo, crop, colors and presentation stay fixed.
